requirements:
This model describes a file system.
It represents oily system elements which can be a folders or files. All file system elements have a name. Every file system element must belong to a folder, and folders can aggregate any number of file system elements. Files have information about their extension and their size.

issues.message: The intermediate UML model does not include the relationship between File and FileSystemElement, which is required by the requirements.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with information about its extension and size.

classes.name: FileSystemElement
classes.description: Represents an oily system element which can be a folder or a file.

classes.name: Folder
classes.description: Represents a folder in the file system which can aggregate any number of FileSystemElement.
